VBO:0200056.summary: Calm around the home and affectionate with its owner, the American Staghound is tenacious when coursing quarry. Bred for hunting ability rather than a uniform show type, its working lines combine speed with endurance over difficult terrain. Greyhound and Scottish Deerhound ancestry remains central, but established Staghound lines have also been bred to one another for generations.
VBO:0200056.shortDescription: An affectionate, tenacious American coursing hound, combining speed and endurance in varied working lines.

sources.title: Glen Kansanback, Running Sage Staghounds — Firsthand breed account
sources.evidence: Credited Glen Kansanback/Running Sage breeder account actually describes calm home behaviour, owner affection, tenacity while coursing, speed and variable endurance; Origin says mainly Greyhound/Scottish Deerhound ancestry and generations of Staghound-to-Staghound breeding; Recognition says selected for work without show standard. Scoped named American working type, not British scent hounds or parent-trait inference. Exclude unsourced universal safety, dominance, health and suitability advice elsewhere on host.

VBO:0201355.summary: Playful and energetic, the Tonya Finosu can combine companionship with watchfulness around the home. This regional dog is associated with Tonya and nearby parts of Trabzon on Turkey’s Black Sea coast. It has been kept to watch houses and the shelters and surroundings of farm animals.
VBO:0201355.shortDescription: A playful regional companion from Tonya, also kept to watch homes and farm-animal shelters.

sources.title: Tonya Finosu — WAD Dünya Anadolu Köpekleri Kinoloji Derneği
sources.evidence: General characteristics names playful and energetic behavior, Tonya/Trabzon breeding region, home companionship and watching homes and farm-animal shelters. No child-suitability, health or world-best guarantees adopted.
